legend: A dacryocystectomy specimen with an inverted papilloma filling the lumen of the lacrimal sac is seen; ribbons of thickened epithelium can be identified within the mass.

legend: An example with thickened surface epithelium composed of closely packed, vertically aligned, spindle-shaped cells with scattered goblet cells is shown; intercellular bridges cannot be identified, although there is slight surface keratinization.

legend: Adjacent to the papilloma, the junction between normal lacrimal sac epithelium and transitional epithelium is seen.

legend: An example with thickened surface epithelium in which there are two microcysts is shown.

legend: Outward growth of papillary fronds with branching fibrovascular cores is seen.
Higher magnification shows the hyperplastic epithelium, predominantly lined by transitional cells; a typical mitotic figure is present (yellow arrow).
